# uds Provider

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "uds" {
  # Enable HTTP-only endpoints when working with registries that do not expose TLS
  insecure_force_http = true

  # Skip TLS verification when using lab certificate authorities or other self-signed certs
  insecure_skip_tls_verification = true
}
```

### Insecure transport options

- `insecure_force_http` -> Forces remote UDS package lookups to use HTTP instead of HTTPS. Defaults to `false`. Can also be set with the `UDS_INSECURE_FORCE_HTTP` environment variable.
- `insecure_skip_tls_verification` -> Skips TLS certificate validation when contacting HTTPS package registries. Defaults to `false`. Can also be set with the `UDS_INSECURE_SKIP_TLS_VERIFICATION` environment variable.
- When both values are enabled the provider mimics the legacy `--insecure` CLI flag by preferring HTTP and skipping TLS verification.
